plugins.name: planr
plugins.description: Close the loop from intent to delivery. Plan, design, build, review, and operate from durable context in your repository.

skills.name: artifact
skills.description: Open, share, import, or export an OpenPlanr HTML artifact review. Use when feedback must move between a local artifact and its review board.
skills.description_zh: 打开、共享、导入或导出 OpenPlanr HTML 产物审阅，使反馈在本地文件和审阅看板间流转。

skills.name: browser-qa
skills.description: Run practical browser-backed QA against real routes, forms, viewports, accessibility, console, and network behavior. Use for UI, authentication, session, navigation, or browser-network changes.
skills.description_zh: 通过真实浏览器对路由、表单、视口、无障碍、控制台和网络行为开展实用 QA，适用于 UI、认证、会话、导航或浏览器网络修改。

skills.name: ceo-review
skills.description: Produce a grounded strategy and finance review for an Operate cycle. Use when direction, runway, margin, investment, or cost of delay needs a CEO lens.
skills.description_zh: 从 CEO 视角对 Operate 周期做有依据的战略财务审阅，关注方向、现金可支撑时长、利润率、投资和延迟成本。

skills.name: chair-review
skills.description: Synthesize an Operate cycle into a prioritized decision queue and action plan. Use after specialist reviews when leadership needs one coherent brief.
skills.description_zh: 在专业评审后，把 Operate 周期综合成按优先级排序的决策队列和行动计划，为管理层提供统一简报。

skills.name: challenger-review
skills.description: Challenge an Operate cycle's claims, alternatives, downside, and confidence. Use when assumptions or executive consensus need an independent stress test.
skills.description_zh: 独立检验 Operate 周期的结论、替代方案、下行情景及置信度，对假设和管理层共识做压力测试。

skills.name: cmo-review
skills.description: Produce a grounded market and growth review for an Operate cycle. Use when acquisition, positioning, demand, retention, or missing measurement needs a CMO lens.
skills.description_zh: 从 CMO 视角审阅 Operate 周期的市场增长，关注获客、定位、需求、留存和缺失的衡量。

skills.name: coo-review
skills.description: Produce a grounded operations and customer-health review for an Operate cycle. Use when readiness, service delivery, capacity, or customer health needs a COO lens.
skills.description_zh: 从 COO 视角审阅 Operate 周期的运营和客户健康，关注准备程度、服务交付、产能及客户状态。

skills.name: cpo-review
skills.description: Produce a grounded product and activation review for an Operate cycle. Use when customer value, activation, prioritization, or adoption needs a CPO lens.
skills.description_zh: 从 CPO 视角审阅 Operate 周期的产品与激活，关注客户价值、优先级和采用率。

skills.name: cto-review
skills.description: Produce a grounded technology and delivery-risk review for an Operate cycle. Use when architecture, reliability, security, or execution risk needs a CTO lens.
skills.description_zh: 从 CTO 视角审阅 Operate 周期的技术和交付风险，关注架构、可靠性、安全与执行。

skills.name: dashboard
skills.description: Start or inspect the loopback-only OpenPlanr planning dashboard. Use when the user wants to view local planning or Operate state in the browser.
skills.description_zh: 启动或检查仅监听本机回环地址的 OpenPlanr 规划看板，在浏览器查看本地规划或 Operate 状态。

skills.name: design-loop
skills.description: Compare three materially different product design directions in a live review studio, collect pins and ratings, and develop the selected direction. Use for visual alternatives, comparison or a remix.
skills.description_zh: 在实时审阅工作室比较三个实质不同的产品设计方向，收集标注和评分，再深化选定方案，支持视觉比较和改编。

skills.name: design-review
skills.description: Review and revise an existing product design using stable board pins and scoped browser-verified changes. Use for focused improvements while preserving unrelated screens and feedback.
skills.description_zh: 依据稳定的看板标注审阅修改已有产品设计，以限定范围和浏览器验证完成重点改进，保留无关页面和反馈。

skills.name: design
skills.description: Design a polished product interface through adaptive consultation, a shared canvas/prototype/walkthrough studio, and an implementation-ready specification. Use for a new design or an existing interface that needs a coherent direction.
skills.description_zh: 通过按需咨询、共享画布、原型与演示工作室设计产品界面，并生成可实施规格，用于新设计或需要统一方向的现有界面。

skills.name: diagram
skills.description: Create, edit, inspect, verify, or rerender professional offline diagrams. Use for architecture, process, sequence, data, state, or relationship visuals from intent or source.
skills.description_zh: 创建、编辑、检查、验证或重新渲染离线架构、流程、时序、数据、状态和关系图，依据需求或来源材料制作。

skills.name: doctor
skills.description: Diagnose OpenPlanr CLI, pipeline, runtime-adapter, installation, and lock health. Use when setup, discovery, versions, generated assets, or runtime behavior seems wrong.
skills.description_zh: 诊断 OpenPlanr CLI、流水线、运行时适配器、安装与锁状态，排查配置、发现、版本、生成产物和运行异常。

skills.name: investigate
skills.description: Diagnose a bug, regression, error, or unexplained behavior and optionally implement a bounded fix. Use for root-cause investigation, not planned feature delivery.
skills.description_zh: 调查缺陷、回归、错误或无法解释的行为，必要时实施范围受限的修复；不用于计划内功能交付。

skills.name: land
skills.description: Assess release readiness and prepare or inspect an OpenPlanr landing sequence. Use after implementation and checks are complete, before merge, publication, or deployment.
skills.description_zh: 在实现和检查完成后评估发布准备度，准备或检查 OpenPlanr 合并发布部署前的落地步骤。

skills.name: openplanr
skills.description: Route a planning, specification, delivery, design, review, diagram, release, or operating request to the best OpenPlanr skill. Use when the right skill is unclear or the request spans several.
skills.description_zh: 将规划、规格、交付、设计、审阅、图示、发布或经营请求路由到合适的 OpenPlanr 技能，适用于入口不清或跨多个技能的需求。

skills.name: operate
skills.description: Run a focused operating review across seven executive lenses and produce a decision and action brief. Use for periodic product or company-level leadership review.
headings: Run the selected lenses (seven by default)
skills.description_zh: 从七种管理层视角开展聚焦经营审阅，生成决策与行动简报，用于产品或公司周期性管理检查。

skills.name: plan-review
skills.description: Review an OpenPlanr plan for product, engineering, design, and developer-experience problems. Use after planning and before implementation to improve the plan.
skills.description_zh: 在规划后实施前审阅 OpenPlanr 计划，找出产品、工程、设计及开发体验问题并完善计划。

skills.name: plan
skills.description: Turn a Protocol-compatible specification or product intent into schema-compatible OpenPlanr stories and implementation tasks. Use for planning and decomposition, not implementation.
skills.description_zh: 将符合 Protocol 的规格或产品意图拆成符合 schema 的 OpenPlanr 用户故事和实施任务，仅做规划分解。

skills.name: release
skills.description: Choose and maintain a product's versioning scheme, classify shipped changes, and write user-facing changelogs or release notes. Use for SemVer or CalVer decisions, version bumps, release cadence, and preparing a versioned release after landing.
headings: Step 3: Choose the scheme (first time only)
skills.description_zh: 选择维护产品 SemVer 或 CalVer 版本规则，分类已交付改动并撰写用户更新记录，支持版本提升、发布节奏和落地后的版本化发布。

skills.name: ship
skills.description: Implement an OpenPlanr plan, specification, task, or clearly stated request end to end in the current repository. Use when the user asks to build, implement, fix, finish, or ship local work.
skills.description_zh: 在当前仓库端到端实现 OpenPlanr 计划、规格、任务或明确请求，支持构建、修复、完成和交付本地工作。

skills.name: spec
skills.description: Shape vague product or engineering intent into a clear, measurable Protocol-compatible specification grounded in the current repository. Use when requirements need clarification before planning or implementation.
skills.description_zh: 依据当前仓库将模糊产品工程意图转成清晰可衡量且符合 Protocol 的规格，在规划或实现前澄清需求。

skills.name: sprint
skills.description: Refine every open backlog item against the code and the calendar, refute the picks, and select a sprint that fits capacity and the release cut. Use before a cut or sprint; not for decomposing one specification or reporting status.
headings: Step 1: Read the calendar and capacity
Step 2: Read every open item in full
Step 5: Write the sprint, the note and the JSON, then stop
skills.description_zh: 结合代码和日历完善所有开放 backlog，检验候选优先级并选出符合容量与发布截止的 sprint；不用于单规格分解或状态汇报。

skills.name: status
skills.description: Inspect project delivery or one feature's pipeline status without changing state. Use when the user asks what is done, pending, blocked, or next.
skills.description_zh: 只读查看项目交付或单功能流水线状态，说明已完成、待做、受阻及下一步，不改变状态。

skills.name: sync
skills.description: Audit OpenPlanr planning artifacts for graph and protocol drift. Use when statuses, references, schemas, or generated planning views may be inconsistent.
skills.description_zh: 审计 OpenPlanr 规划产物中的图关系和协议偏移，检查状态、引用、schema 及生成视图是否一致。
